d3TokenDecision.currentEffectiveBehavior: Unset is treated as enabled with zero spread; legacy mUSDC weight is 10000 bps, yielding discount 10000 bps.
d3TokenDecision.example: For a 100.000000 mUSDC effective seizure target and sufficient balance, 5 bps spread requires 100.050026 mUSDC gross seizure; effective credit is 100.000000 after integer rounding. This is on the liquidation penalty target, not the trade notional.
d3TokenDecision.justification: mUSDC is the only currently listed Vault collateral token and the base token. The frozen D3 source cites a 0..5 bps typical stable-token spread; 5 bps is the upper end of that example, gives a small liquidation incentive, and remains a discretionary testnet policy choice rather than a protocol requirement.
d3TokenDecision.equityEffect: The trader loses the full gross token amount transferred to the liquidator; the planner credits only the discounted effective amount. The spread adds to any separate liquidation penalty and needs explicit operator acceptance.
d3TokenDecision.unsupportedTokens: D3 setter accepts nonzero unsupported addresses, but valuation rejects a token not supported by Vault; do not configure them.
d3TokenDecision.oracleDependency: Base mUSDC valuation avoids token/base conversion. Any future non-base token needs Vault support, legacy collateral weight, oracle price and the D3 600-second freshness check.

d2FeeDecision.feeBasis: PERP matched-trade notional; D2 distinguishes maker/taker and ORDERBOOK/RFQ, not opening versus closing. D4 charges each matched side separately. OPTION fee basis is premium and is outside this recommendation.
d2FeeDecision.rfqDiscounts: Keep currently zero PERP RFQ discounts; no RFQ activation is authorized.
d2FeeDecision.historicalComparison: The historical 2-bps-per-side target would charge 4 bps total across one maker and one taker. This 0/2 bps proposal charges 2 bps total, and lowers current tier-0 defaults from 0.5/3 bps. It is a new testnet proposal, not automatic reuse of legacy policy.
d2FeeDecision.example: On 100.000000 mUSDC notional, maker charge 0 and taker charge 0.020000 mUSDC, before any separately authorized trading path.
d2FeeDecision.recipientRole: Current D2 recipient and owner is ProtocolTimelock. It may receive an internal CollateralVault account credit if D4 later charges fees; this is governance-controlled revenue, not an InsuranceFund deposit or D2 custody transfer. Later treasury withdrawals/routing need separate review.
d2FeeDecision.protocolFeeVault: Keep zero; fee hooks disabled. Do not claim ProtocolFeeVault bucket accounting or InsuranceFund funding. A future fee-vault route requires separate address, backing, accounting and authorization review.
d2FeeDecision.rebatePolicy: No maker rebates in any PERP tier; keep rebateFundingAccount=zero, mUSDC rebateBudget=0 and Merkle root=zero until separately backed and reviewed. Do not copy legacy liability.

legacyLiability.treatment: Keep entirely on legacy ledger; no migration, writeoff or duplicate funding authorized

d2FeeDecision.activationBoundary: D2 policy approval and separate per-tier governance reviews precede C24, C14 and C15. D4 emergency flags and D6 pause remain. No new fee consumer or trading activation in this milestone.
d2FeeDecision.approval: REQUIRED; approve all five PERP tier profiles, recipient, no-rebate/no-vault posture, and OPTION exclusion explicitly
